fullDesc: On July 7, 1928 the Chillicothe Baking Company in Missouri sold the first commercially sliced bread, cut by a machine invented by Otto Rohwedder. It soon spread across the United States.
realFacts: Wonder Bread began selling sliced loaves in 1930
The slicing machine took Rohwedder years to perfect
A 1943 wartime ban on sliced bread was quickly reversed
